character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
The creature is a MEGA-LEVEL DIGITAL SEA MONSTER.

CORE CONCEPT:
A gigantic armored marine beast combining:
- ancient sea turtle
- deep-sea reptile
- naval fortress
- digital monster

It must look like an original monster design, NOT a humanoid and NOT a direct copy of any existing creature.

BODY:
Very large, heavy quadrupedal body.

Its anatomy resembles an ancient armored sea turtle mixed with a powerful marine reptile.

Broad chest, thick muscular legs, large clawed feet and a short but powerful neck.

The creature should feel extremely heavy and durable, like a living ocean fortress.

HEAD:
Large reptilian sea-monster head.

Strong squared jaw.

Short armored snout.

Small but intense CYAN-BLUE glowing eyes.

Two short metallic fins/horns extend backward from the sides of the head.

The jaw and cheeks have pale silver armor plates.

Its expression should look:
calm,
experienced,
powerful,
protective.

Not evil.

SHELL:
The most important feature.

A gigantic DARK NAVY and STEEL-BLUE armored shell covers its back.

The shell looks like a fusion between:
ancient turtle shell + futuristic naval armor.

Use LARGE armor plates rather than hundreds of tiny mechanical details.

Several subtle cyan glowing lines run between the shell plates like digital energy circuits.

The shell should have a recognizable silhouette even when the sprite is small.

WATER CANNONS:
Two large WATER-ENERGY CANNONS emerge from the upper shell.

IMPORTANT:
Do NOT make them look like simple metal gun barrels.

They should look like biological/digital organs integrated into the shell.

Each cannon has:
- thick armored base
- dark navy exterior
- silver edges
- glowing cyan interior
- transparent blue energy chamber

Inside each cannon, water energy visibly circulates.

When attacking, they fire extremely compressed streams of glowing digital water.

Place the cannons slightly angled upward and outward.

ARMS AND LEGS:
Four thick limbs.

Front limbs are larger and heavily armored.
